body:
`hollow-test` fails CLOSED when every diff-derived file produces zero mutants (#658, `bin/hollow-test.mjs:703`). That rule is CORRECT and must not be relaxed: a diff that changes real code and yields no mutant IS unverified.

But it currently fires on a diff that changes **only comments**, where there is no changed behaviour to mutate at all. The tool already has a "not a mutable source type" bucket for `.md`/`.json`/test files — reported, not covering, not a failure. A `.mjs` file whose diff hunks touch only comment and blank lines belongs in that bucket. Its own error message names three causes and collapses them into one exit:

    no mutable line was found (comment-only, blank, or a shape none of the mutation operators recognize)

REPRODUCTION (PR #1034, branch fix/995-996-handoff-drift):

    error: diff-derived file(s) produced zero mutants — packages/context-handoff/lib/adapter.mjs,
    plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook-run.mjs, plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs,
    plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs: ...

Non-comment changed lines measured per file: adapter.mjs 0, adlc-hook.mjs 0, adlc-handoff-gate.mjs 0. adlc-hook-run.mjs reports 2 but both are the same line `handoff: 10_000,` whose VALUE is unchanged — only its trailing comment moved, and the literal is masked by the off-by-one tuning-constant mask.

SCOPE — READ THIS TWICE. Fix ONLY the comment-only cause. The third cause ("a shape none of the operators recognize") MUST keep failing closed: that is a real code change the gate could not see, which is #1031's territory, not this one. An `import`-only or `export`-only diff is REAL CODE and must still fail closed.

THE DANGER, stated plainly. packages/hollow-test/lib/targets.mjs carries this warning in its own comments: "A coverage gate that reports green by not looking is worse than no gate, and this one hid itself." Excluding files from the gate IS not looking. If the predicate wrongly classifies a real code change as comment-only, a genuine unverified change passes silently — reopening the vacuous-pass class #70/#41/#35/#658 exist to close. Every ambiguity MUST resolve to "this is code" (keep failing closed), never to "this is a comment".

WHAT TO BUILD

1. In packages/hollow-test/lib/targets.mjs, a predicate that answers: given a file's CURRENT content and the set of changed 1-based line numbers, does every changed line contain NOTHING but comment text and whitespace?

2. It must be a real scanner over the WHOLE file, not a per-line `^\s*//` regex, because comment state crosses lines. The cases that MUST be right:
   - a line inside a multi-line `/* ... */` block is a comment
   - a line inside a MULTI-LINE TEMPLATE LITERAL is CODE even when it reads as `// like this`. This is the trap; a naive scan calls it a comment and skips a real string-content change.
   - `code(); // trailing comment` is CODE
   - `/* closed */ code();` is CODE (packages/core/lib/mutate.mjs documents this exact shape as #372 defect 4)
   - blank / whitespace-only lines count as "not code"
   - a line with only `*` continuation inside a block comment is a comment
   You do NOT need to distinguish a regex literal from division: both are code, so a line is already marked code at the first non-comment character. Regex literals cannot span lines, so no regex state is needed at all. Say so in a comment, since it is non-obvious.

3. FAIL CLOSED on anything the scan cannot classify. If the file ends in an unterminated block comment or unterminated template literal, the scan is untrustworthy — treat the file as CODE and let the existing refusal stand. Same if a changed line number is outside the file.

4. In bin/hollow-test.mjs, drop comment-only files from `diffEligibleFiles` BEFORE the #658 refusal, and REPORT them. A green gate must never be a silent green — print the skipped files and the reason, the way the existing "not a mutable source type" report does. If EVERY diff-eligible file is comment-only, the run legitimately has nothing to verify and must exit 0 with that stated.

RAILS: packages/core/lib/mutate.mjs and scripts/mutation-gate.mjs. The mutation OPERATORS and the wrapper must not change — this ticket changes only which files are selected. If either seems to need editing, stop and say so.

WRITE THE RED TESTS FIRST, in packages/hollow-test/test/:
  - the #1034 reproduction: a diff touching only comment lines in a .mjs file exits 0, and names the skipped file
  - a diff touching a comment AND one real code line still mutates, and still fails closed if that mutant survives
  - THE TEMPLATE-LITERAL TRAP: a changed line that looks like `// comment` but sits inside a multi-line template literal is treated as CODE and still fails closed
  - a line inside a real multi-line block comment IS treated as a comment
  - `code(); // trailing` is CODE
  - `/* closed */ code();` is CODE
  - an import-only diff STILL fails closed (the third cause is out of scope and must not regress)
  - an unterminated block comment / unterminated template makes the file CODE (fail closed)
  - #658's existing tests (test/diff-zero-mutants.test.mjs, test/starved-budget.test.mjs) still pass UNCHANGED

ACCEPTANCE
- Every red test fails before the change and passes after.
- test/diff-zero-mutants.test.mjs and test/starved-budget.test.mjs pass with NO edits — show this explicitly.
- `npm test` green from the repo root, output shown.
- `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs` exits 0 on the diff (this change is real code, so it must produce and kill its own mutants).
- `adlc rails-guard --base origin/main --ticket <this ticket id>` exits 0.
title: hollow-test: classify a comment-only diff as not-covered instead of failing closed (#1032)
